notes.title: The second patch is here!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are happy to inform you that a second big update has just landed – there is a lot of improvements and bug fixes along with some gameplay changes. We hope you will like what we have prepared for you! [b]Please enjoy the improved Inner Chains![/b]

Gameplay:
- Melee tutorial added in Chapter 1.
- Removed a bug that let the players get a weapon in Chapter 1.
- Removed a bug that made the weapon disappear.
- Players receive „the gift” in the beginning of Chapter 1.
- [b]Head Bobbing can now be disabled.[/b]
- Improved collision detection.
- Sound effects fixes and additions. 

Story:
- [b]Narration added for Chapters 1, 2, 3 and 4. [/b]
- Narration added for the monument scene.
- All new narration has been translated to every available language.
- Improved the achievement system.

Performance:
- Improved optimization.
- Improved streaming.
- Players can no longer skip checkpoints.
- [b]Support for AMD chipsets.[/b]

Graphics:
- Improved lightning.
- Support for more resolutions, especially for 21:9 monitors, in the menu.
- [b]FOV can now be adjusted.[/b]

[b][u]Of course, that is not the end of updates.[/u][/b] Currently, we are working on even better optimization for the whole game, more bug fixing, more gameplay improvements and an option to change the key bindings!

We will inform you as soon as we have more news!

Sincerely,
The Telepaths' Tree team

notes.title: Update on... an update
notes.content:
Dear Players,

[b]It's been some time since we shared the news with you.[/b] We are aware we promised that a new patch is going to be released this week - however, based on your feedback, [b]we decided to record new lector voiceovers for introductions to the chapters[/b], which required additional time on our side. We also managed to find a solution to the problems with AMD processors.

Additionally, [b]we implemented the FOV slider[/b], one of your most popular requests. You can now also switch the bobblehead effect on and off, as well as [b]play Inner Chains properly on ultrapanoramic screens[/b]. The final thing we need to do before the next update gets published is the key rebindings option, as we didn't put it now.

That should not take us more than a few more days, so hopefully, you will be able to play updated Inner Chains next week!

Thank you for your patience,
[b]You are the best![/b]
The Telepaths' Tree Team

notes.title: The first patch is here!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Players,[/b]

After a few days of intensive work, we are ready to introduce the first patch for Inner Chains. We have listened to all the feedback from you and tried to fix as much as possible in this first update. It doesn't mean we're finished – we will continue working on improvements and definitely want to hear more of your feedback so please do not hesitate to share your suggestions or issues with us.

If Steam doesn't start the update automatically, please make sure to restart the application.

The improvements are:

[b]Graphics[/b]

-V-Sync ON/OFF settings added.
-Antialiasing ON/OFF settings added.
-Motion blur ON/OFF settings added.
-Grain ON/OFF settings added.
-Chromatic aberration ON/OFF settings added.
-Medium graphics settings preset added.

[b]Sound[/b]

-New sound effects added.

[b]Controls[/b]

-Camera sensitivity settings added for mouse and gamepad.
-Camera invert settings added for mouse and gamepad.

[b]Gameplay[/b]

-Melee tutorial added in Chapter II.
-Zombie speed movement is increased by 20% now.
-Enemies' reaction range is now increased.
-Enemies are now paralyzed for a shorter time period after being hit by electro gun.
-Electro gun now needs less time until you can shoot it again.
-The Boss fight now starts automatically after some time if the player doesn't attack.
-The Boss fight cannot be avoided anymore but it is slightly easier.

[b]Various[/b]

-You can now skip the Intro.

We are currently working on the option to disable head bob and menu localizations - you can expect those changes soon as really small updates to the game being downloaded by Steam.

Next big patches will bring more gameplay changes and AI improvements but we need some time to prepare those. Telepaths' Tree is a small studio with less than 10 people on deck and we are working constantly to make Inner Chains better - all we need from you is a little more patience. And a smile! ːsteamhappyː

By the way - all saves should work with the newest version of the game. If they don't, restart the current chapter or send us your save file and we will repair it for you.

Sincerely,
[b]The Telepaths' Tree team[/b]

notes.title: Break your Inner Chains now!
notes.content:
Inner Chains, the long-awaited horror FPS from developer Telepaths’ Tree and global publisher IMGN.PRO is finally here! Get ready for a mesmerizing adventure in a surreal and deadly biomechanical world unlike anything you’ve seen before.

[h1]The game is out now and you can buy it 10% off for the next seven days.[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26496197/25310149e28f829aaea26149e683ba5f70f7e5bc.jpg[/img]

The time has finally come to enter the vast, surreal world of Inner Chains and try to discover its secrets. But beware – you are an intruder here and the inhospitable fauna and flora will make sure you are reminded of that fact. You’ll need to have eyes in the back of your head and stay focused at all times to prove that your appearance will bring a change to this dark, twisted universe.

As one of the inhabitants of this world, your head is filled with the teachings of the Ruling Caste. You have only one goal: to get to a mythical place called the Last Hope and leave this sick, degenerated, dying planet once and for all. You embark on your journey full of fanatical zeal, but soon it becomes clear that nothing is what it seems in this strange world.

Watch the trailer:

https://youtu.be/U1E9PWpLgwQ

Thank You All for your support and your patience. Enjoy the Inner Chains!

You can contact us via Steam, Facebook or email any time - do not hesitate to do so if you have any questions or suggestions!

We are all here for you to ensure you have the best experience possible!

[b]The Telepaths' Tree team[/b]
